text: the app itself is very good, cozy and cute. its just the fact that as a free user you only have 3 habit limit. this will drive a lot of people away and uninstall the app like how I will after writing this feedback. id suggest giving unlimited habits for free users (like another app – Hizo), its already limited as it is.
